description: Studio Code asks which of four looks to build for a slow-fashion journal (design-looks/), Moire's own among them.

content.text: Moire sounds lovely. Let's settle the look first: here are four directions, each drawn as a design board. Pick one and I'll show you layouts in it.

options.label: Dia journal
options.description: Moire's own: a huge brown wordmark on Dia yellow, Poppins and Libertinus Serif.

options.label: Quiet linen
options.description: Oat and sage, a soft serif, and lots of air around the cloth.

options.label: Monochrome atelier
options.description: Black on white, a heavy grotesque in capitals, garments on rails.

options.label: Deep wool
options.description: Navy and rust on parchment, a bookish serif, close-up textures.
